summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual degradation and 3D inconsistency in long autoregressive rollouts for action-controlled video generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method for multimodal generation and world simulation. It identifies two failure modes in long-horizon AR video generation: information loss from latent-RGB cycling and a train-inference gap from clean-memory training. This is moderately relevant to stability questions in multimodal autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust Dreamer introduces Latent Gaussian Memory, anchoring diffusion latents to Gaussian primitives so the system avoids repeatedly decoding latents to RGB and re-encoding them for future conditioning. It also uses deviation-aware memory handling so training better matches corrupted inference-time memory states.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data, or exact metric gains. The experiments target frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation, with emphasis on long-rollout fidelity and 3D consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Vertex Lab and the Australian National University.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 drift ablation；它对文本预训练不直接有用，但长 AR 生成的误差累积诊断可借鉴。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and drift ablations; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the error-accumulation diagnosis for long AR generation transfers.

paper.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
paper.abstract: As video diffusion models (VDMs) advance toward world models, a key question arises: do they truly understand causality, or merely overfit to statistical temporal patterns? Existing benchmarks mostly rely on synthetic data, limiting real-world generalization due to the sim-to-real gap. We present YoCausal, a two-level benchmark inspired by the Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm from cognitive science. By temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost as natural counterfactual samples,

summary.core_problem: 评估视频生成模型是否具备因果理解，而不是只学到时间顺序上的统计相关性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成世界模型评测。YoCausal 用真实视频的时间反转构造自然反事实样本，避免纯合成 benchmark 的 sim-to-real 缺口，并区分“感知时间箭头”和“理解因果”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法受认知科学中的 Violation of Expectation 范式启发，设计两级评估。Level 1 用 Reverse Surprise Index 通过 denoising loss 衡量模型对时间箭头的敏感性；Level 2 用 VLM 将数据分成 causal 和 non-causal 子集，再用 Causality Cognition Index 分离因果认知与普通时间偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 13 个视频扩散模型。核心发现是：模型能感知时间箭头并不意味着能理解因果；部分模型的时间方向敏感性可能来自非因果的时序统计偏置。摘要未列出具体模型规模、训练数据和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether video generation models understand causality or merely fit statistical temporal patterns.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a world-model-oriented benchmark for video generation. YoCausal uses temporally reversed real-world videos as natural counterfactuals, reducing the sim-to-real gap of synthetic-only evaluation and separating arrow-of-time perception from causal cognition.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by the Violation of Expectation paradigm, the benchmark has two levels. Level 1 defines the Reverse Surprise Index based on denoising loss to measure arrow-of-time sensitivity. Level 2 uses a VLM to stratify data into causal and non-causal subsets, then defines the Causality Cognition Index to separate causal reasoning from temporal bias.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video diffusion models. The main finding is that perceiving the arrow of time does not imply causal understanding; some temporal sensitivity can be explained by non-causal temporal bias. The abstract does not provide model scales, training data, or full numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 读 RSI/CCI 定义和 causal/non-causal 分层；这类反事实评测比看视频质量分更接近世界模型问题。
recommendation.en: Read the RSI/CCI definitions and the causal versus non-causal split; this counterfactual setup is more informative for world-model claims than video-quality scores.

paper.title: GAP3D: Generative Alignment of VLM Latents to Patch-Level Embeddings for 3D Generation
paper.abstract: Recent approaches integrating vision-language models (VLMs) as prompt encoders for generative model conditioning typically rely on expensive end-to-end training or map features to compressed representations, discarding the dense spatial structure required for geometry-aware tasks like 3D asset generation. To address this, we propose GAP3D, a modular, diffusion-based approach that aligns VLM-generated latents directly to the complete, patch-level feature space of a pre-trained image encoder, enab

summary.core_problem: VLM 作为生成模型提示编码器时，常把特征压缩成全局表示，丢掉 3D 生成所需的 patch-level 空间结构。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态条件生成中的 latent alignment 方法：让 VLM latent 对齐到预训练图像编码器的 dense patch embedding，从而复用冻结的下游 3D 生成模型，并减少对大规模 3D 数据的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: GAP3D 是模块化 diffusion 方法，将 VLM 生成的 latent 映射到完整 patch-level image encoder feature space，而不是端到端重训生成模型或只对齐压缩向量；下游生成模型保持冻结，条件信号保留空间结构。
summary.experiments: 论文在 3D asset generation 上评测，主要用通用图文对训练该对齐模块，而不是依赖大规模 3D 数据；摘要称具备从纯文本训练中涌现出的多模态提示 zero-shot 能力，但未给出具体数据规模、模型参数或指标提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the loss of dense spatial structure when VLMs are used as prompt encoders through compressed representations for 3D generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent-alignment method for multimodal conditional generation: mapping VLM latents to dense patch-level image-encoder embeddings so that a frozen 3D generator can use spatially structured conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach: GAP3D aligns VLM-generated latents directly to the full patch-level feature space of a pretrained image encoder. It avoids expensive end-to-end retraining and avoids collapsing the conditioning signal into a compact global embedding.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 3D asset generation and is trained mainly on general image-text pairs rather than large-scale 3D data. The abstract reports zero-shot multimodal-prompt behavior despite text-only training, without giving concrete scale or metric numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM latent 对齐案例可看方法图；结论偏 3D 生成，预训练研究员不必读实验细节。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look as a VLM latent-alignment case study; the conclusions are 3D-generation-specific, so skip the experimental details.

paper.title: Squeezing Capacity from Multimodal Large Language Models for Subject-driven Generation
paper.abstract: Subject-driven image generation aims to synthesize new images that preserve the identity of the given subject while following textual instructions. Existing approaches often encode text and reference images separately. This limits cross-modal reasoning abilities and causes copy-paste artifacts. Recent frameworks that connect multimodal models and diffusion models improve instruction following, but largely overlook identity preservation. To address these limitations, we condition diffusion models

summary.core_problem: 解决主体驱动图像生成中，文本指令跟随和参考主体身份保持难以同时做好的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MLLM 条件控制下的图像生成方法改进。它把多模态大模型的联合图文编码能力用于扩散模型条件，并补充 VAE 身份细节，对 AR+diffusion 或 MLLM-to-generator 接口有一点参考价值，但不是基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用 MLLM 同时编码文本和参考图像，避免传统方法把文本与图像分开编码带来的跨模态推理不足。再加入 VAE-based identity conditioning 保留主体细节；提出 Dual Layer Aggregation 模块聚合多层 MLLM 特征作为扩散条件；推理时使用多阶段 denoising，在高层语义和低层身份细节之间逐步调节。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了 extensive experiments，并显示方法能同时改善 instruction following 与 identity preservation，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses subject-driven image generation where identity preservation and text-instruction following are hard to optimize simultaneously.
summary_en.importance: This is a method improvement for MLLM-conditioned image generation. It uses the joint text-image encoding capability of multimodal LLMs as conditioning for diffusion models, with additional VAE-based identity control. It is mildly relevant to MLLM-to-generator interfaces, but not to foundation LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method conditions a diffusion model on MLLM features that jointly encode text and reference images, instead of separately encoding the two modalities. It adds VAE-based identity conditioning, introduces a Dual Layer Aggregation module to combine multi-level MLLM features, and uses multi-stage denoising at inference time to balance semantic instruction information with fine identity details.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments and claims improved balance between instruction following and identity preservation, but it does not provide model size, data scale, baseline names, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 可看 DLA 和分阶段去噪设计；作为 MLLM 条件扩散接口备查，不值得投入预训练时间。
recommendation.en: Skim the DLA and staged denoising design; keep it as a reference for MLLM-conditioned diffusion, not as pretraining material.

paper.title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
paper.abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. Both natural images and critical physic

summary.core_problem: 把无条件图像生成和连续倍率超分辨率统一为同一个跨尺度反向扩散过程。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散建模中的 forward process 设计：把尺度作为扩散动态的显式坐标，用一个模型覆盖从生成到超分辨率的不同起点。对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对 diffusion/flow 类生成范式的噪声过程设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SKILD 在 k-space 中构造 scale-invariant diffusion：前向过程从细到粗衰减图像内容，同时注入与频谱匹配的高斯噪声。训练后的同一个反向过程根据起始 timestep 的不同执行无条件生成或连续超分辨率，不需要任务专用架构、conditioning branch、classifier-free guidance，也不需要为不同放大倍率重训。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该框架在自然图像和临界物理系统的尺度不变性假设下工作，并展示 generation 与 continuous super-resolution 的统一能力。未给出具体数据集、模型规模、baseline 数字或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: William T. Freeman 和 Marin Soljačić 是 MIT 相关方向的知名研究者，长期涉及计算视觉、物理启发学习和生成建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper unifies unconditional image generation and continuous super-resolution as the reversal of scale-dependent information loss.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a diffusion forward-process design for image generation: scale becomes an explicit coordinate of the dynamics, allowing one model to cover generation and super-resolution from different starting timesteps. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to noise-process design in diffusion and flow-style generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: SKILD defines a scale-invariant k-space diffusion process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise. The same learned reverse process performs either unconditional generation or continuous super-resolution by changing only the starting timestep, without task-specific heads, conditioning branches, classifier-free guidance, or per-scale retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports demonstrations on natural images and critical physical systems, motivated by scale invariance in both domains. It does not provide dataset details, model scale, baseline tables, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: William T. Freeman and Marin Soljačić are well-known MIT researchers associated with computational vision, physics-inspired learning, and generative modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读结果表，重点看 forward process；把尺度写进噪声动态这点，可迁移思考到离散扩散 LM。
recommendation.en: Do not spend time on the result tables; inspect the forward process, since encoding scale into the noise dynamics may transfer to discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解决视频生成和编辑中的接口问题：如何让 MLLM 负责语义理解和规划，让 diffusion/flow 模型负责像素生成，同时避免把两者粗糙拼接成一个难训练的端到端系统。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近统一多模态预训练和新型生成建模接口设计。核心价值在于它选择 MLLM 内部的 ViT embedding space 作为语义桥梁，而不是让 MLLM 直接生成离散图像 token、文本 prompt，或让 diffusion 模型只依赖外部文本编码器。这个选择有两个含义：第一，视觉语义计划落在 MLLM 已经熟悉的连续表征空间里，减少适配成本；第二，生成器接收的是目标画面的高层视觉表示，而不只是语言描述，因此更适合复杂编辑、参考图/参考视频约束和主体保持。
summary.technical_approach: Bernini 由两部分组成。Planner 是一个 MLLM，它接收统一序列化的多模态输入，包括文本、源图像/视频的 ViT tokens，以及目标输出的占位 tokens。它不直接输出像素，而是在 MLLM 的 ViT embedding space 中预测目标视觉语义表示。训练时采用 masked generative modeling：随机 mask 目标 ViT tokens，在 MLLM hidden states 上接轻量 ViT embedding decoder，恢复被 mask 的目标 embedding；推理时从全 mask 状态开始逐步填充目标语义 tokens。Renderer 是 DiT，使用 flow matching 在 VAE latent tokens 上生成图像或视频，通过 cross-attention 接收 planner 给出的语义 embedding，并结合文本特征；做编辑任务时额外注入源输入的 VAE latent，以保留低层细节和时序一致性。为了统一多源视觉输入，论文提出 Segment-Aware 3D RoPE，在时空 RoPE 中加入 segment index 相关的相位调制，避免多个图像/视频源在位置编码上混淆。另一个设计是 latent-space CoT：让 planner 在连续视觉语义空间中进行中间推理，再输出最终 target embedding。训练策略上，两部分可以大体独立训练，再轻量联合调整，这有利于保留 MLLM 的理解能力，也降低整体训练难度。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 text-to-video、subject-to-video、图像/视频编辑等任务，并构造了多任务训练数据：视频和图像 pair 预训练数据、基于传播和运动感知的视频编辑数据、参考图和参考视频引导生成数据。评测包括 OpenVE-Bench、OpenS2V-Eval，以及论文提出的 Bernini-Bench。给出的结论是 Bernini 在多个视频生成、编辑和主体保持评测上优于对比系统，尤其在需要理解复杂指令、多参考输入和保持主体一致性的设置中收益更明显。当前提供的正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token/clip 数量和逐项指标，阅读时需要回到实验表格核对具体幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Fig. 3 和方法部分，确认 planner 到 renderer 的接口到底传什么：是 ViT semantic embeddings，而不是文本 prompt 或 VAE latent。然后看 masked ViT embedding prediction 的训练/推理流程、SA-3D RoPE 的定义、编辑任务中源 VAE latent 的注入方式。实验部分重点看多任务数据构造和 ablation：没有 semantic planner 会怎样，只用文本条件会怎样，去掉 source VAE features 或 SA-3D RoPE 会怎样。对基座研究更有用的是“连续语义计划 + diffusion 渲染”的分工设计，而不是具体视频 demo。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the interface problem between multimodal understanding and video synthesis: how to let an MLLM perform semantic planning while a diffusion-style generator renders pixels, without forcing both roles into a brittle end-to-end design.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining and generation-interface design. The central choice is to use the MLLM’s own ViT embedding space as the semantic bridge to the generator. This is more informative than passing only a text prompt, and more natural for the MLLM than directly producing pixels or low-level VAE latents. It also creates a clean separation: the MLLM predicts what should appear in a compact visual-semantic space, while the DiT handles photorealistic rendering and detail preservation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bernini has two main modules. The planner is an MLLM that consumes a unified multimodal sequence containing text, source visual tokens, and target placeholders. It predicts the target visual representation in continuous ViT-embedding space. Training follows a masked generative modeling setup: target ViT tokens are randomly masked, and a lightweight ViT-embedding decoder on top of the MLLM reconstructs the missing target embeddings from contextual hidden states. At inference, the planner progressively fills in the full target representation starting from masked tokens. The renderer is a DiT trained with flow matching over VAE latent tokens. It conditions on the planner’s semantic embeddings through cross-attention, also uses text features, and for editing tasks receives source VAE features to preserve low-level appearance and temporal consistency. The paper also introduces Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, which adds segment-index-dependent phase modulation to spatiotemporal rotary embeddings so that multiple visual sources can coexist in one sequence. A latent-space CoT mechanism lets the planner perform intermediate reasoning before producing the final target embedding.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on text-to-video generation, subject-to-video generation, and image/video editing. The training corpus combines video and image-pair pretraining data, propagation-based and motion-aware video editing data, and reference-image/reference-video guided generation data. Evaluation includes OpenVE-Bench, OpenS2V-Eval, and a new Bernini-Bench. The reported results show consistent gains over compared systems, with stronger effects in settings that require complex instruction following, multiple visual references, editing consistency, and subject preservation. The provided text does not include the full model scale, data scale, or all numeric metric values, so the exact margins should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Fig. 3 and the method description to understand the planner-renderer contract: the planner outputs ViT semantic embeddings, not text prompts or VAE latents. Then read the masked ViT-embedding prediction procedure, Segment-Aware 3D RoPE, and the source-VAE conditioning path for editing. In the experiments, focus on the multi-task data construction and ablations: removing the semantic planner, replacing it with text-only conditioning, removing source VAE features, or dropping SA-3D RoPE. The useful idea for foundation-model researchers is the continuous semantic planning interface between MLLM reasoning and diffusion rendering.

recommendation.zh: MLLM+扩散的分工架构值得了解一下，语义接口的设计思路对多模态统一预训练有参考价值。重点看规划器和渲染器的接口设计。
recommendation.en: The MLLM-diffusion division-of-labor architecture is worth understanding; the semantic interface design offers insights for unified multimodal pretraining. Focus on the planner-renderer interface design.

paper.title: Guided Trajectory Optimization with Sparse Scaling for Test-Time Diffusion
paper.abstract: The efficient Test-Time Scaling (TTS) paradigm offers a promising perspective for enhancing the generation performance of diffusion models. However, current solutions are limited to a static, pre-defined noise pool and suffer from inflexible noise exploration across the denoising trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose RTS, a novel Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling method to fully unlock the generative potential of diffusion models. Unlike existing methods, RTS facilitates the synthesis of ref

summary.core_problem: 提升扩散图像生成模型的 test-time scaling 效率和效果，避免固定噪声池带来的搜索僵化。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散模型推理期搜索方法。它不是语言建模工作，但 reward-guided test-time compute allocation 对理解生成模型的推理期扩展有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RTS 提出 Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling：一方面用 reward signal 优化噪声，使搜索主动朝高质量样本区域移动；另一方面用 sparse test-time scaling 只在关键 denoising step 上投入额外搜索。PCA-driven curvature analysis 用来识别轨迹中更值得扩展的中间步骤，从而压缩搜索空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 RTS 在 GenEval Score 上相对 baseline 提升 15.6%，ImageReward 分数提升 60.4%。未从摘要中看到模型规模、采样预算、reward model 细节和完整 baseline 设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Guangdong University of Technology、South China University of Technology 和 Nanyang Technological University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves test-time scaling for diffusion image generation by replacing static noise-pool exploration with guided trajectory optimization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time search method for image diffusion models. It is not language modeling, but its reward-guided compute allocation is a useful analogy for test-time scaling in generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTS introduces Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling. It optimizes noise using reward feedback to steer sampling toward promising regions, and applies sparse test-time scaling only at selected denoising steps. A PCA-driven curvature analysis identifies important intermediate steps and reduces the search space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 15.6% improvement in GenEval Score and a 60.4% improvement in ImageReward over baselines. Model scale, sampling budget, reward-model setup, and full baseline details are not visible from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Guangdong University of Technology, South China University of Technology, and Nanyang Technological University.

recommendation.zh: 作为扩散版 inference scaling 旁证即可；若采样预算未严格对齐，60% ImageReward 提升要打折看。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an image-diffusion analogue of inference scaling; if sampling budgets are not tightly controlled, the 60% ImageReward gain should be discounted.

paper.title: Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance for Flow Models under Compositional Rewards
paper.abstract: Inference-time guided sampling steers state-of-the-art diffusion and flow models without fine-tuning by interpreting the generation process as a controllable trajectory. This provides a simple and flexible way to inject external constraints (e.g., cost functions or pre-trained verifiers) for controlled generation. However, existing methods often fail when composing multiple constraints simultaneously, which leads to deviations from the true data manifold. In this work, we identify root causes of

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 flow / diffusion 模型在推理时同时满足多个 reward 或约束时的偏移问题。普通 additive guidance 会把多个 reward 梯度直接相加；当这些梯度方向冲突时，采样轨迹容易离开训练数据流形，导致 pretrained vector field 在低密度区域失准。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在生成模型的“预训练先验 + 推理时控制”接口。它说明 reward composition 不是简单加权问题，梯度几何会直接影响样本是否还处在模型学到的分布附近。这个结论对 diffusion LM、flow matching LM、跨模态生成模型都有参考意义：如果后训练或推理时控制信号互相冲突，只优化 reward 可能会破坏预训练先验。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析 approximate guidance 的误差来源，把 guided sampling 的近似误差分成 coupling shift、gradient misalignment 和 localized approximation error 三项。关键观察是，在多个 reward 的组合场景里，误差会随 reward 数量 G 和梯度平均夹角项 1 - cos phi 增大而快速放大。基于这个分析，作者提出 Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance，即 CAR guidance。它不是改动底层 flow 模型，也不是使用代价更高的 exact guidance，而是在推理时检测 reward 梯度之间的冲突，并用一个 conflict-aware gating 机制只在冲突明显的区域激活可学习修正项。这样保留 additive guidance 的轻量和可插拔特点，同时减少 off-manifold drift。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 2D 合成分布、像素空间图像编辑、状态空间规划和 3D 点云机器人操作。结果集中验证一个点：当 reward 数量增加或目标互相牵制时，普通 guidance 容易提高约束满足率但损害样本保真度，CAR guidance 在两者之间更稳。论文报告图像编辑中 identity preservation 提升 25.4%；规划任务 success rate 提升 38.75%；机器人操作里 violation rate 降低 78%，success 从 9% 提升到 61%。这些数字说明方法主要收益来自冲突场景，而不是单一约束下的常规 guidance 调参。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 off-manifold drift 的问题设定，Section 4 的误差分解和梯度错配项，这是最有信息量的部分。方法部分关注 gating 何时启动、修正项如何学习、是否依赖 reward 类型。实验部分优先看 compositional reward 的消融：reward 数量、梯度夹角、样本保真度和约束满足率之间的关系。若关心 LLM 或 diffusion LM，可重点借鉴它对“多个训练/推理信号冲突”的诊断方式，而不是具体机器人任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies inference-time guidance for flow and diffusion-style generative models under multiple simultaneous rewards. Standard additive guidance simply sums reward gradients. When these gradients disagree, the sampling trajectory can be pushed away from the data manifold, where the pretrained vector field is poorly calibrated.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model pretraining is the interface between a pretrained generative prior and runtime control signals. The paper makes a concrete point: composing rewards is not only a matter of choosing weights. The geometry of reward gradients determines whether guidance preserves the learned distribution. This is useful for diffusion LMs, flow-matching LMs, and multimodal generative models where post-training or inference-time objectives may conflict with the pretrained prior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first derives an error decomposition for approximate guided sampling. The approximation error is separated into coupling shift, gradient misalignment, and localized approximation error. The key term is gradient misalignment: in compositional reward settings, the error grows with both the number of rewards G and an angular disagreement factor, 1 - cos phi. This motivates Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance, or CAR guidance. CAR keeps the lightweight nature of additive inference-time guidance, but adds a conflict-aware gating mechanism. The gate detects regions with strong reward-gradient disagreement and selectively activates a learnable correction term. This avoids the cost and rigidity of exact guidance while reducing off-manifold drift.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 2D synthetic benchmarks, pixel-space image editing, state-based planning, and 3D point-cloud robotic manipulation. The reported gains are largest in settings with genuinely competing constraints. In image editing, identity preservation improves by 25.4%. In planning, success rates increase by 38.75%. In robotic manipulation, violation rates are reduced by 78%, and success rises from 9% to 61%. The experiments support the paper’s central claim: naive guidance can improve reward satisfaction at the cost of sample fidelity, while conflict-aware correction better preserves the pretrained generative prior.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the problem setup in the introduction, then focus on the theoretical section that decomposes guidance error and identifies the gradient-misalignment term. In the method section, check when the gate is activated, how the correction is learned, and whether the mechanism assumes a specific reward family. In the experiments, prioritize ablations over the number of rewards, gradient conflict, constraint satisfaction, and sample fidelity. For LLM or diffusion-LM work, the most transferable idea is the diagnostic treatment of conflicting control signals, not the specific robotics setup.

recommendation.zh: 对流模型推理时引导采样的多约束组合问题有实际insight，对思考扩散LM的可控生成（如多reward引导）有参考价值，重点看梯度冲突检测机制。
recommendation.en: Useful insight on multi-constraint composition in flow model guided sampling; relevant for thinking about controllable diffusion LM generation with composite rewards; focus on gradient conflict detection mechanism.

paper.title: Tiny-Engram: Trigger-Indexed Concept Tables for Generative Vision
paper.abstract: Current personalization methods for generative vision models typically encode new concepts through continuous adapters or weight updates, yet provide limited control over whether and when a concept should be retrieved. In this work, we introduce Tiny-Engram, a compact trigger-indexed concept table that gives visual memories an explicit lexical address and activation boundary inside frozen image and video generators. Tiny-Engram parameterizes each concept as a small set of memory entries indexed

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视觉个性化中，新概念通常通过连续 adapter 或权重更新写入模型，但缺少显式“何时触发、何时不触发”的检索边界。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成中的参数高效个性化与可控记忆注入。对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值不在图像生成本身，而在“触发词索引的外部概念表”这一记忆寻址设计，和离散检索式知识注入有类比空间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tiny-Engram：在冻结的图像/视频生成器外接一个小型 trigger-indexed concept table。每个概念由少量 memory entries 表示，通过注册的 n-gram 匹配触发，只在匹配到的 trigger span 内调制 text encoder hidden states；未触发时条件路径与原模型完全一致。该设计可用于 latent diffusion 和多编码器 diffusion-transformer。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在单编码器 latent diffusion 与多编码器 DiT 骨干上都验证了方法，能把稀有触发短语绑定到目标身份，同时保留周围 prompt 的组合控制；还把同一表式记忆评估到文本条件视频生成。未给出具体数据集、参数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of explicit retrieval boundaries in personalized generative vision, where new concepts are usually injected through continuous adapters or weight updates without clear control over when they should activate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits in parameter-efficient personalization and controllable memory injection for multimodal generation. For a pretraining researcher, the value is not image generation per se, but the idea of a trigger-indexed external concept table, which resembles discrete retrieval-style knowledge injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tiny-Engram attaches a small trigger-indexed concept table to frozen image/video generators. Each concept is represented by a few memory entries activated by registered n-gram matches, and these entries modulate text-encoder hidden states only within the matched trigger span; outside that span, the conditioning path is identical to the frozen base model. The method is applied to both latent diffusion and multi-encoder diffusion-transformer backbones.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims validation on both single-encoder latent diffusion and multi-encoder DiT backbones, showing that a rare trigger phrase can be bound to a target identity while preserving compositional control from the surrounding prompt. The same table-based memory is also evaluated in text-conditioned video generation. No concrete datasets, model sizes, or gains are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“只在触发 span 注入记忆、其余路径保持 frozen-identical”这个设计很干净；做外部记忆/概念绑定的人可借鉴，其他人看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'inject memory only on the trigger span while keeping the rest frozen-identical' design is clean; useful if you care about external memory or concept binding, otherwise the abstract is enough.

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Buil

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成与编辑里“语义规划”和“像素渲染”耦合过紧的问题，希望把 MLLM 的高层语义能力与 diffusion 的视觉生成能力更干净地拼接起来。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态生成框架设计：提出用语义表示作为接口，把 MLLM 负责的语义规划与 DiT 负责的像素渲染解耦。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一点接口设计启发，但它更偏视频生成系统，而不是 LLM 基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，先用基于 MLLM 的 planner 直接在 ViT embedding 空间预测目标语义表示，再由 DiT-based renderer 在该语义计划条件下生成视频像素；编辑场景下再加入源视频的 VAE 特征以保留细节。核心设计是把“语义”作为 planner 和 renderer 的中间接口，因此两部分可以分开训练，只做轻量协同训练，尽量复用各自已有预训练能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体基线名称，只说明覆盖视频生成与编辑任务，并强调在保留预训练能力的同时实现统一框架。由于缺少定量细节，目前更适合把它当作架构接口思路，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM 预训练 recipe 的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tight coupling between semantic planning and pixel rendering in video generation/editing, aiming to combine MLLM-level semantic grounding with diffusion-based visual synthesis through a cleaner interface.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal generation framework: using semantic representations as the interface between an MLLM planner and a DiT renderer. This offers some interface-design signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still much more a video generation system paper than a foundation-LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses an MLLM-based planner to predict target semantic representations directly in ViT embedding space, then a DiT-based renderer generates pixels conditioned on that plan. For editing, source VAE features are added to preserve details. The key idea is to treat semantics as the contract between planner and renderer, enabling separate training with only light co-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, training corpus scale, or named baselines. It claims unified support for video generation and editing while preserving pretrained capabilities. Given the lack of quantitative detail, this is better read as an interface proposal than as strong evidence for transferable LLM-pretraining methodology.

recommendation.zh: 更像视频生成系统整合，不是 pretrain 论文；只需看它如何把“语义接口”从像素生成里剥离，若你在想 AR+diffusion 联合建模，这个接口定义可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a video generation integration paper, not a pretraining one; only read it for the semantic-interface split if you're thinking about AR+diffusion unification.

paper.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Diffusion Models through Iterative Partial Refinement
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a major approach for improving reasoning capabilities, and has been increasingly applied to diffusion models. However, existing inference-time scaling methods for diffusion models typically rely on external verifiers or reward models to rank and select samples, limiting their scalability to settings where such evaluators are available and reliable. Moreover, while recent diffusion models perform sequential inference with region-wise, mixed-noise conditioning

summary.core_problem: 解决顺序式 diffusion 生成在推理阶段如何不依赖外部 verifier、仅靠模型自身反复修正局部区域来提升样本质量与决策一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理时扩展而非训练目标创新，贡献主要是为 sequential diffusion 提出一种不依赖 reward model 的 test-time refinement 方案；对研究 inference-time scaling、以及理解 diffusion 与 AR 在测试时计算分配上的差异有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Iterative Partial Refinement（IPR）：从已生成样本出发，只对部分区域重新加噪，再在其余区域条件下重生成该子区域。核心想法是让早先做出的局部决策在更完整上下文下被重审，而不是一次性定稿。方法针对 region-wise、mixed-noise conditioning 的 sequential diffusion 设定，避免了外部打分器或 verifier。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验重点应是比较 IPR 与现有 diffusion inference-time scaling 方法在无 verifier 条件下的效果，考察迭代局部重采样是否能稳定提升生成质量或任务表现。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、基线名称和提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为方法思路了解，而不是据此更新强 prior。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to scale inference in sequential diffusion models without external verifiers, by letting the model iteratively revise only parts of an already generated sample.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time method rather than a training-objective contribution. Its value is in proposing a verifier-free refinement scheme for sequential diffusion, which is relevant if you care about test-time compute allocation and how diffusion differs from AR decoding under extra inference budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Iterative Partial Refinement (IPR): starting from a completed sample, the method re-noises a subset of regions and regenerates them conditioned on the untouched regions. The key idea is to revisit earlier local decisions with richer global context, instead of committing in a single pass. The method is designed for region-wise sequential diffusion with mixed-noise conditioning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments likely compare IPR against prior diffusion inference-time scaling approaches under settings without external verifiers, testing whether iterative local regeneration improves sample quality or downstream performance. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or exact gains, so this is more of a method-to-note than a result that should strongly update priors.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你在看 diffusion-style LM 或统一生成范式，可以只读方法图和实验主表：它提示了“局部重采样”可能是 diffusion 的 test-time compute 基元。
recommendation.en: Not central to pretraining, but if you're tracking diffusion-style LM or unified generation, read the method figure and main table only: it suggests partial resampling as a plausible test-time compute primitive for diffusion.

paper.title: Enhancing Train-Free Infinite-Frame Generation for Consistent Long Videos
paper.abstract: Without incurring significant computational overhead, train-free long video generation aims to enable foundation video generation models to produce longer videos. Frame-level autoregressive frameworks, e.g., FIFO-diffusion, offer the advantage of generating infinitely long videos with constant memory consumption. However, the mismatch between training and inference, coupled with the challenge of maintaining long-term consistency, limits the effective utilization of foundation models. To mitigate

summary.core_problem: 解决 train-free 长视频生成中，frame-level autoregressive diffusion 推理与基础模型训练分布不匹配、长程一致性差的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成推理方法，不是 LLM 预训练。相关性主要来自长序列生成中的训练-推理 gap 和一致性维护，这两个问题与语言模型长上下文生成有弱类比。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MIGA，一种无需训练的 infinite-frame 长视频生成方法。方法包含两阶段 alignment，用于减少送入模型的过大噪声跨度；还引入 dual consistency enhancement，包括 self-reflection 修正早期高噪声帧，以及 long-range frame guidance 利用后期低噪声帧引导生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在不显著增加计算开销的情况下提升长视频一致性，并延续 FIFO-diffusion 类方法的常量内存优势。未给出具体基础视频模型、生成长度、指标提升或用户评测数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses train-free long-video generation, where frame-level autoregressive diffusion suffers from training-inference mismatch and weak long-term consistency.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time video generation method rather than LLM pretraining work. Its relevance is limited to the general issue of training-inference mismatch and consistency in long sequential generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIGA is a train-free infinite-frame generation method. It uses a two-stage alignment mechanism to reduce the excessive noise span fed to the base model, and a dual consistency mechanism: self-reflection for correcting early high-noise frames and long-range frame guidance from later low-noise frames.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved long-video consistency without significant extra compute while preserving the constant-memory property of FIFO-style frame autoregression. It does not provide model names, generation lengths, metric deltas, or human evaluation numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为长序列生成的类比材料即可；读方法图，不必追实验，和 LLM 预训练的耦合很弱。
recommendation.en: Use it only as an analogy for long sequential generation; skim the method figure, but the coupling to LLM pretraining is weak.

paper.title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
paper.abstract: We present Pelican-Unified 1.0, the first embodied foundation model trained according to the principle of unification. Pelican-Unified 1.0 uses a single VLM as a unified understanding module, mapping scenes, instructions, visual contexts, and action histories into a shared semantic space. The same VLM also serves as a unified reasoning module, autoregressively producing task-, action-, and future-oriented chains of thought in a single forward pass and projecting the final hidden state into a den

summary.core_problem: 现有具身智能模型多采用独立模块拼接的流水线架构，感知、推理、世界建模、动作策略四部分相互割裂，存在语义断层、泛化性差、长时序任务误差累积等问题。
summary.importance: 提出具身智能的统一建模范式，为多模态预训练向具身场景扩展提供架构设计参考，验证了共享表示联合优化的可行性，不需要在各专项能力上做性能妥协。
summary.technical_approach: 采用单VLM作为共享的理解与推理模块，将场景、指令、视觉上下文、动作历史映射到统一语义空间，自回归生成面向任务、动作、未来的思维链并输出隐变量；后续接统一未来生成器（UFG），基于该隐变量在同一扩散去噪过程中用两个模态头同时生成未来视频和底层动作；训练时语言、视频、动作损失同时回传到共享表示层，实现四类能力联合优化。
summary.experiments: 单checkpoint在三类任务上表现突出：8个VLM基准得分64.7，同等参规模型中最优；WorldArena基准得分66.03，排名第一；RoboTwin动作基准得分93.5，对比方法中平均排名第二。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节统一范式的定义、第3节模型架构设计、第4节核心实验结果，跳过相关工作和冗余实验细节部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing embodied intelligence models adopt a pipeline architecture stitched with independent modules, leading to fragmentation across perception, reasoning, world modeling and action policy, which causes semantic gaps, poor generalization, and error accumulation in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a unified modeling paradigm for embodied intelligence, provides architecture design references for extending multimodal pretraining to embodied scenarios, and verifies that joint optimization of shared representations requires no performance tradeoff across individual specialized capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single VLM serves as the shared understanding and reasoning module, which maps scenes, instructions, visual contexts and action histories into a unified semantic space, autoregressively generates task-, action- and future-oriented chains of thought, and outputs the corresponding latent variable. A Unified Future Generator (UFG) conditions on this latent variable, and generates both future videos and low-level actions via two modality-specific heads within the same diffusion denoising process. During training, language, video and action losses are all backpropagated to the shared representation layer to enable joint optimization of four capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: A single checkpoint achieves strong performance across three task categories: 64.7 on 8 VLM benchmarks, best among models with comparable parameter scale; 66.03 on WorldArena, ranking first; 93.5 on RoboTwin action benchmark, second average rank among compared methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the definition of unified paradigm, Section 3 for model architecture design, Section 4 for core experiment results. Skip related work and redundant experiment details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 具身智能统一建模的尝试——用单一VLM+扩散生成器连接推理、视频预测和动作生成。共享表示学习的思路对多模态预训练有一定参考。只看方法架构部分即可。
recommendation.en: An attempt at unified embodied intelligence — a single VLM + diffusion generator connecting reasoning, video prediction, and action generation. The shared representation approach has some reference value for multimodal pretraining. Just read the architecture section.

institutions: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics (X-Humanoid)

paper.title: Compositional Video Generation via Inference-Time Guidance
paper.abstract: Text-to-video diffusion models generate realistic videos, but often fail on prompts requiring fine-grained compositional understanding, such as relations between entities, attributes, actions, and motion directions. We hypothesize that these failures need not be addressed by retraining the generator, but can instead be mitigated by steering the denoising process using the model's own internal grounding signals. We propose \textbf{CVG}, an inference-time guidance method for improving compositiona

summary.core_problem: 现有文本生成视频扩散模型在处理需要细粒度组合理解的提示时表现不佳，无法正确生成实体间的关系、属性、动作和运动方向等组合约束，现有提升组合性的方案需要重新训练生成器、额外标注数据或人工输入控制信号，成本较高。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需修改生成视频模型主干的推理时控制方案，仅通过利用模型自身内部的交叉注意力信号即可提升组合生成的保真度，为多模态生成模型的推理时对齐提供了一种低成本的通用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CVG框架，核心是利用生成视频扩散模型内部的交叉注意力图已经编码了提示概念在时空维度上的定位信息这一特性；在冻结的VLM主干上训练一个轻量组合分类器，仅输入提示中实体对应token的交叉注意力图，预测组合关系的正确性；训练时采用视频版本的对偶反转技术，避免分类器利用注意力信号中的浅层文本痕迹（组合泄漏）；推理时仅在去噪的早期阶段，将分类器预测与目标组合标签的交叉熵损失的梯度反向传播到潜变量，引导去噪过程向符合组合约束的方向更新，同时保留生成模型原有的视觉质量。
summary.experiments: 在组合性文本生成视频基准上测试，CVG在组合保真度指标上同时优于基础生成器和布局引导的TTOM基线，且不会破坏生成视频的原有视觉质量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法部分中组合分类器的输入设计和对偶反转的实现逻辑，理解如何避免分类器直接读取组合token而不是从注意力中学习组合关系；查看实验部分中不同引导阶段对结果的影响消融；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-video diffusion models perform poorly on prompts requiring fine-grained compositional understanding, failing to correctly generate compositional constraints such as relations between entities, attributes, actions, and motion directions. Existing methods to improve compositionality require retraining the generator, additional annotated data, or manually provided control signals, leading to high costs.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an inference-time control scheme that does not require modifying the backbone of text-to-video generation models, improving compositional faithfulness only by leveraging the model's own internal cross-attention signals, providing a low-cost general approach for inference-time alignment of multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The CVG framework is built on the observation that cross-attention maps inside text-to-video diffusion models already encode the spatiotemporal localization of prompt concepts. A lightweight compositional classifier is trained on top of a frozen VLM backbone, taking only cross-attention maps of entity tokens in the prompt as input to predict the correctness of compositional relations. A video version of dual inversion is adopted during training to prevent the classifier from exploiting superficial textual traces in attention signals (composition leakage). During inference, gradients of the cross-entropy loss between classifier predictions and target compositional labels are backpropagated to update latents only in early denoising steps, steering the denoising process to satisfy compositional constraints while preserving the original visual quality of the generator.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on compositional text-to-video benchmarks, CVG outperforms both base generators and the layout-guided TTOM baseline on compositional faithfulness metrics, without degrading the original visual quality of generated videos.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the input design of the compositional classifier and the implementation of dual inversion in the method section to understand how the classifier is prevented from directly reading composition tokens instead of learning compositional relations from attention. Review the ablation study on the impact of different guidance stages in the experiments section. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 利用模型内部注意力信号做推理-time组合引导的思路对多模态生成有借鉴意义，核心观察（交叉注意力自带grounding）值得注意。看§3方法部分。
recommendation.en: The observation that cross-attention maps inherently encode spatial-temporal grounding is a useful insight for multimodal generation research. Read §3 (method) only.

paper.title: L2P: Unlocking Latent Potential for Pixel Generation
paper.abstract: Pixel diffusion models have recently regained attention for visual generation. However, training advanced pixel-space models from scratch demands prohibitive computational and data resources. To address this, we propose the Latent-to-Pixel (L2P) transfer paradigm, an efficient framework that directly harnesses the rich knowledge of pre-trained LDMs to build powerful pixel-space models. Specifically, L2P discards the VAE in favor of large-patch tokenization and freezes the source LDM's intermedia

summary.core_problem: 如何在几乎不收集真实数据、低算力条件下，把预训练latent diffusion的生成能力迁移到像素空间扩散模型，并支持超高分辨率生成。
summary.importance: 提供一种“从latent到pixel”的迁移范式：冻结大部分预训练扩散网络、只学浅层映射，并用合成数据自举训练；对生成模型预训练/迁移与数据闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出L2P：去掉VAE，改用大patch tokenization；冻结源LDM的中间层，仅训练浅层以学习latent-to-pixel变换；训练数据完全来自源LDM生成的合成图像，从“已平滑的流形”上快速收敛；去除VAE带来的显存瓶颈以解锁原生4K生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键指标与对比细节；宣称仅用8张GPU训练、可实现原生4K生成，并在多组实验中验证（具体baseline/提升幅度需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to transfer a pretrained latent diffusion model into a pixel-space diffusion model with minimal compute and no real-data collection, while enabling ultra-high-resolution generation.
summary_en.importance: A transfer paradigm from latent to pixel space: freeze most of a pretrained diffusion backbone, learn a shallow mapping, and bootstrap training purely from synthetic samples—useful as a reference for generative pretraining/transfer and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: L2P removes the VAE and uses large-patch tokenization; freezes intermediate layers of the source LDM and trains only shallow layers to learn a latent-to-pixel transformation; trains solely on images synthesized by the source LDM to fit an already-smooth manifold; removing the VAE alleviates memory bottlenecks to unlock native 4K generation.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks concrete metrics and baselines; claims training with 8 GPUs and native 4K generation, with extensive experiments (details require the paper).

recommendation.zh: 更像“扩散模型迁移/蒸馏”的工程范式：只看冻结策略+纯合成数据闭环是否真能不崩（重点查对比与失败案例）。
recommendation.en: An engineering-heavy diffusion transfer recipe; worth checking whether the freeze+synthetic-only loop is actually stable—focus on baselines and failure modes, not the narrative.

paper.title: Conservative Flows: A New Paradigm of Generative Models
paper.abstract: Modern generative modeling is dominated by transport from a noise prior to data. We propose an alternative paradigm in which generation is performed by a discrete stochastic dynamics that leaves the data distribution invariant, initialized from data-supported states rather than from noise. The framework can utilize any pretrained flow model. We develop two probability-preserving sampling mechanisms, a corrected Langevin dynamics with a Metropolis adjustment and a predictor-corrector flow, that o

summary.core_problem: 探讨生成模型是否必须从噪声分布传输到数据分布，并提出一种从数据支撑状态出发、保持数据分布不变的采样范式。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在生成建模范式和采样机制：它把 flow / diffusion 常见的“噪声到数据”生成视角，改成围绕数据分布不变测度运行的离散随机动力学。对文本预训练不是直接贡献，但对 diffusion LM、flow matching LM 和多模态生成的采样设计有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Conservative Flows，可复用已有 pretrained flow checkpoint。核心包括两类概率保持采样器：带 Metropolis 校正的 Langevin dynamics，以及 predictor-corrector flow。二者都试图在不重新训练主模型的情况下，修正原采样过程并保持目标数据分布不变。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 synthetic Swiss-roll、ImageNet-256 和 Oxford Flowers-102。摘要称这些采样器相对原始生成过程有稳定改进，但未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、具体 baseline 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The University of British Columbia 和 University of Cambridge；Eldad Haber 在数值优化、反问题和深度学习建模方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether generative models must sample by transporting noise to data, and proposes generation via stochastic dynamics that preserve the data distribution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly conceptual and algorithmic for generative modeling: it replaces the usual noise-to-data transport view with probability-preserving dynamics initialized on data-supported states. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it may inform sampling designs for diffusion LMs, flow-matching LMs, and unified multimodal generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conservative Flows can operate on existing pretrained flow checkpoints. The paper introduces two samplers: a corrected Langevin dynamics with a Metropolis adjustment, and a predictor-corrector flow. Both are designed to improve sampling while preserving the target distribution rather than retraining the base generator.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation includes a synthetic Swiss-roll target, ImageNet-256, and Oxford Flowers-102. The abstract reports consistent improvements over the original generation procedures, but does not provide model sizes, training scale, exact baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of British Columbia and the University of Cambridge. Eldad Haber is known for work on numerical optimization, inverse problems, and learning-based modeling.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 预训练不是主线；只看采样框架即可，值得拿来对照 diffusion LM 的“反向过程是否只能从噪声起步”。
recommendation.en: Not central to LLM pretraining; skim the sampler formulation as a useful foil for whether diffusion LMs must start from noise.

paper.title: WavCube: Unifying Speech Representation for Understanding and Generation via Semantic-Acoustic Joint Modeling
paper.abstract: Integrating speech understanding and generation is a pivotal step toward building unified speech models. However, the different representations required for these two tasks currently pose significant compatibility challenges. Typically, semantics-oriented features are learned from self-supervised learning (SSL), and acoustic-oriented features from reconstruction. Such fragmented representations hinder the realization of truly unified speech systems. We present WavCube, a compact continuous laten

summary.core_problem: WavCube 解决的是语音统一建模中的表示不兼容问题：语音理解通常依赖 WavLM、HuBERT 这类 SSL 语义特征，语音生成通常依赖 Mel 或 VAE 声学 latent。前者适合理解但丢失部分高频和相位相关细节，后者适合重建但语义结构弱，扩散模型也更难学习。论文试图构造一个紧凑连续 latent，同时服务理解、重建和生成。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对语音 LM 和跨模态统一预训练有启发。它把语音表示从“理解 encoder”和“生成 codec/latent”两套系统，推进到一个共享连续空间。贡献不在于单个 TTS 指标，而在于提出了语音版的 representation-centric generation 路线：先用强 SSL 模型提供语义拓扑，再通过压缩和声学补偿把它变成可扩散、可解码的生成 latent。对后续做 speech-native multimodal pretrain、AR+diffusion 混合建模、latent-space reasoning 的模型都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用两阶段的 compress-then-enrich 设计。第一阶段冻结 WavLM-Large，从 1024 维 SSL feature 中蒸馏出 128 维 bottleneck。这个 bottleneck 不是简单降维，而是作为信息瓶颈，去掉 SSL 表示中对 diffusion 不友好的冗余和 off-manifold 变化。论文同时 warm up 一个声学 decoder，但对 latent 做 detach，避免声学重建目标反向破坏语义蒸馏。第二阶段面向重建保真度做声学增强，弥补 SSL 表示天然丢掉的细粒度声学线索，使同一个 latent 既能保留语义结构，又能被解码成高质量语音。与直接使用 Mel/VAE latent 相比，WavCube 更强调语义结构；与直接使用 WavLM feature 相比，它显式处理了高维冗余和扩散学习难度。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的诊断实验很关键：直接把 1024 维 WavLM-Large feature 喂给 diffusion transformer 会失败。一个 338M 参数 DiT 在 zero-shot TTS 上得到约 110% WER，基本不可读；把 DiT 放大到 753M 后，声学质量仍然很差。这说明问题不是单纯靠放大生成模型解决，而是 latent 空间本身不适合 diffusion。WavCube 的 128 维 bottleneck 用更小的环境维度约束生成空间，缓解 manifold drift；声学补偿阶段则针对 SSL 特征的重建缺口。由于提供的正文片段未包含完整表格，具体理解任务、重建指标和生成指标的最终数值不宜补写。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对两类表示冲突的分析，以及 Sec. 5 的系统诊断，尤其是 raw WavLM feature 导致 diffusion 失败的实验。方法部分重点看两阶段训练如何隔离语义蒸馏和声学重建目标：为什么 Stage 1 要冻结 SSL encoder、为什么要 128 维 bottleneck、为什么 acoustic decoder warm-up 需要 detached latent。实验部分建议关注三个对照：直接 SSL feature、传统 acoustic latent、WavCube bottleneck。最值得深挖的是连续语音 latent 是否能和离散 speech token 共存，以及这种 latent 能否被统一 LM 直接建模。

summary_en.core_problem: WavCube targets a representation mismatch in unified speech modeling. Speech understanding usually relies on SSL features from models such as WavLM or HuBERT, while speech generation usually relies on Mel spectrograms or VAE-like acoustic latents. SSL features carry useful semantic structure but miss fine acoustic details. Acoustic latents reconstruct well but are less semantically organized and harder for diffusion models to learn. The paper aims to build one compact continuous latent for understanding, reconstruction, and generation.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the representation design, not only the TTS result. WavCube brings a representation-centric generation recipe to speech: start from a strong SSL speech encoder, compress its redundant feature space into a diffusion-friendly latent, then enrich the latent with acoustic information needed for decoding. This is relevant to speech-native language models, unified multimodal pretraining, and AR-plus-diffusion systems where one latent space has to support both comprehension and synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a two-stage compress-then-enrich pipeline. In Stage 1, WavLM-Large is frozen and its 1024-dimensional features are distilled into a 128-dimensional bottleneck through a symmetric adapter-based autoencoder. The bottleneck acts as an information constraint: it removes redundant SSL variation that makes diffusion training unstable and prone to off-manifold samples. An acoustic decoder is warmed up in parallel, but the latent is detached so that reconstruction loss does not interfere with semantic distillation. Stage 2 then adds acoustic enrichment to recover fine-grained information that SSL training tends to discard. Compared with Mel or VAE latents, WavCube has stronger semantic organization. Compared with raw WavLM features, it explicitly reduces ambient dimensionality and makes the space easier for a diffusion transformer to model.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic result is the most informative part. Directly feeding 1024-dimensional WavLM-Large features into a diffusion transformer fails badly: a 338M-parameter DiT gives around 110% WER on zero-shot TTS, and even a 753M variant still has poor acoustic fidelity. This supports the paper’s main claim that scaling the generator is not enough when the latent space is too redundant and poorly constrained. The 128-dimensional WavCube bottleneck addresses this by reducing the diffusion target space, while the acoustic enrichment stage closes the reconstruction gap. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact final numbers for downstream understanding, reconstruction, and generation are not filled in.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s diagnosis of semantic versus acoustic representations. Then read the diagnostic section that tests raw WavLM features with diffusion, because it explains why a compact latent is needed. In the method section, focus on the separation between semantic distillation and acoustic reconstruction: frozen SSL encoder, 128-dimensional bottleneck, detached latent during decoder warm-up, and the later enrichment step. In the experiments, compare raw SSL features, conventional acoustic latents, and WavCube. A good follow-up question is whether this continuous speech latent can coexist with discrete speech tokens in a unified language-modeling stack.

recommendation.zh: 语音 tokenizer 方向值得 skim；重点看 bottleneck 是否真解决 raw SSL diffusion 难题，别只看重建指标。
recommendation.en: Skim if you track speech tokenizers; focus on whether the bottleneck really fixes raw-SSL diffusion, not just reconstruction metrics.

paper.title: P-Guide: Parameter-Efficient Prior Steering for Single-Pass CFG Inference
paper.abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for high-fidelity conditional generation in flow matching, yet it imposes significant computational overhead by requiring dual forward passes at each sampling step. In this work, we address this bottleneck by introducing \textbf{P-Guide}, a framework that achieves high-quality guidance through a single inference pass by modulating only the initial latent state. We further show that, under a first-order approximation, P-Guide is equivalent to CFG in the

summary.core_problem: 解决 flow matching 生成中 CFG 需要每步双前向、推理成本高的问题，希望用单次前向实现接近的条件引导效果。
summary.importance: 这是生成模型推理加速工作，不是 LLM 预训练论文。它对 AR+diffusion 联合建模或统一生成系统的研究者有边缘参考价值，主要贡献是单步 guidance 的参数高效近似。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 P-Guide，通过只调制初始 latent state 来实现 single-pass guidance。作者声称在一阶近似下，P-Guide 与 CFG 在“从 prior 空间进行 steering”这一点上等价，因此不需要在采样过程中显式做 velocity field extrapolation。进一步考虑同方差与异方差先验，并联合建模均值和方差，以实现自适应 loss attenuation 和更强的噪声/不确定性鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要称相较标准双前向 CFG，可将推理延迟降低约 50%，同时保持接近的保真度和 prompt alignment。但未给出具体模型、数据集、采样步数、FID/CLIP 等指标，也未说明在何种 flow matching backbone 上验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high inference cost of classifier-free guidance in flow matching, aiming to recover similar conditional guidance quality with a single forward pass.
summary_en.importance: This is a generative-model inference acceleration paper rather than an LLM pretraining paper. It has some peripheral relevance for researchers interested in AR+diffusion unified modeling, with the main contribution being a parameter-efficient single-pass approximation to CFG.
summary_en.technical_approach: P-Guide performs guidance by modulating only the initial latent state, enabling single-pass inference. Under a first-order approximation, the authors argue that P-Guide is equivalent to CFG in the sense that it steers generation from the prior space without explicit velocity-field extrapolation during sampling. They also study both homoscedastic and heteroscedastic priors, jointly modeling mean and variance for adaptive loss attenuation and improved robustness to uncertainty.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims roughly 50% lower inference latency than standard dual-pass CFG while maintaining competitive fidelity and prompt alignment. However, it does not specify the backbone models, datasets, sampling schedules, or evaluation metrics such as FID or CLIP alignment.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 关系不大，但若你关心 unified generative stack，可看它如何把 CFG 近似改写成 prior steering；实验细节不全，先当工程想法看。
recommendation.en: Only loosely relevant to LLMs, but if you care about unified generative stacks, look at how CFG is reframed as prior steering; treat it as an engineering idea until the setup is clearer.
